LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_Tip: Turns KCSG structure layouts of a loaded mod into CBF pieces in your project. Use it for layouts you made yourself or may reuse.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_None: No loaded mod has KCSG structure layouts.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_NoTarget: No target folder. Open or create a project first.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_Unreadable: {0} was written but could not be read back.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_Pawns: {0} pawn cell(s) left out; CBF populates sites itself.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_Layers: More than three layers: {0} cell(s) moved to the third layer, {1} lost.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_NoneInFolder: No KCSG structure layouts in this folder.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_UnreadableFiles: Import incomplete: {0} file(s) are not readable XML and were skipped: {1}
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_NotPending: This piece is not an unsaved import.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_FolderHint: Pick a mod or enter a folder. All KCSG buildings in it are added to the piece list, unsaved. Keep the ones you want there one by one; the rest is lost when you quit.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_FolderTip: Root folder of a mod. Subfolders for other game versions are skipped.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_KeepTip: Saves this piece to your project. Then set its category and anchors.
LanguageData.CBF_Kcsg_DiscardTip: Removes this imported piece again without saving it.
